method.name: Smoothed diagonal Gaussian elite search (CEM-style)
method.note: Seed-matched comparisons; action/state-dependent random draws may diverge, not guaranteed identical per-transition noise.

limitations: Scratch adapter and four-parameter policy family only, not implemented product.
Two scenario-specific training runs; second uses first selected policy as a warm candidate, not a general transfer guarantee.
Single base seed and bounded disjoint run-index pools; more base seeds/scenarios required.
Final results never tune the candidate; repeated product promotions need fresh evaluation and sequential-testing control.
Bun Windows x64 timing is not Node ARM Lambda billed duration or AWS cost.
No AWS profile performed; USD5/month enforcement remains a release gate.
No global optimum, clinical validity or lifetime outbreak-prevention claim.
